checks.name: The reader returns the current category cohort
Queue-name advice comes from the same owned catalog read
File Info's connection and speed defaults are prepared off the window thread
Only wizard preferences cross the preparation boundary, without credentials
History is bounded, absolute and deduplicated before controls are built
Preparation changes no job, catalog or accepted-decision guard
A new-download wizard keeps its supplied optional per-file defaults
Post-capture processing and notification do not retain Manager
A real model writer precedes wizard preparation
The caller remains free while the advisory reader waits for Manager
One wizard cannot create duplicate outstanding preparation workers
Cancel settles model acquisition before the external writer must release
An unrelated accepted write defers advisory schedule preparation
Cancelling advisory work preserves another command's accepted guard
Preparation failure is returned without leaving an outstanding reader
The same owner can Retry after a consumed preparation failure
A throwing wake callback cannot undo an already-published result
Owned snapshots retain their values while a later request sees current defaults
An absent history member cannot supply per-file defaults
A preparation snapshot predates a competing queue creation
Authoritative commit rejects a queue created after advisory validation without adding a download
Listed scheduling prepares its target and previous queue on the owned reader
Original download comparisons and editable defaults come from one catalog snapshot
A new listed schedule does not invent an existing revision queue
An accepted listed save still rejects download edits made after its original-state snapshot
A download made ineligible before the reader acquires Manager cannot become an editable listed wizard
An ordinary queue is not accepted as an editable one-time schedule
A listed preparation request must retain an actual download
Revision preparation retains the actual editable queue and original UTC window
Revision fields are coherent and do not suggest moving the download from another queue
An already scheduled download cannot silently receive another independent listed schedule
An accepted revision still rejects a queue changed after preparation
A fresh request obtains the changed revision queue rather than reusing an earlier result
